journey.name: definite pre-broadcast payment request failure can retry
journey.description: Verifies that a private Payment Request remains payable after its first send fails before Lightning dispatch. Requires the linked fixture issuer, a funded regtest Lightning wallet, and the local LNURL server configured as described in README.md. Keep the same Paykit payment list published for both attempts.

actions.action: Launch the E2E Bitkit app with Paykit UI enabled, the fixture issuer saved and linked, and the LNURL-pay invoice callback configured to fail
Have the issuer publish the failing LNURL-pay endpoint under identifier "btc-lightning-lnurl" and send a proposed one-time Payment Request for 21,000 sats
Verify the LNURL payment review shows 21,000 sats (testTag "ReviewAmount-primary" or "ReviewAmount-secondary", depending on the primary display setting)
Verify the send failure screen (testTag "SendFailure") appears
Configure the same LNURL-pay invoice callback to succeed without publishing a new Paykit payment list
Tap Try Again (testTag "Retry") without waiting for the next foreground request poll
Verify the LNURL payment review appears again with 21,000 sats (testTag "ReviewAmount-primary" or "ReviewAmount-secondary", depending on the primary display setting)
Verify the payment success screen (testTag "SendSuccess") appears
